question_text: Maria was born in 1990 in the Philippines to a Filipino mother and an American father who was not a diplomat. At the time of her birth, the 1987 Constitution was in effect. What is Maria's citizenship status?

options.text: Maria is a Filipino citizen because the Philippines follows jus sanguinis (blood relationship) and her mother is Filipino.
Maria is a dual citizen because her mother is Filipino and her father is American.
Maria is an American citizen because her father is American, and the Philippines follows jus soli (place of birth).
Maria is stateless because her parents have different nationalities.
